rule: Each event is a clock or entry trigger, then one roll, then a cooldown (per place or per player), then a fixed sequence of timed beats with a hard cap on what can join. Faction state is a per-planet tally recomputed on a fixed server clock, with a lead ladder that scales a crackdown difficulty value. Wild scans take at most one roll per planet per cycle and stop after the first success. Cantina ambushes roll on entry, spawn one harasser after 15 s, escalate in timed beats and call in up to three backups that leave after 300 to 360 s. Space ambushes spawn a squad 600 to 1200 units ahead of the target with a leader that others follow. Spawn director (space area): total cap, per-type cap, weighted roll over groups, and a 60 s grace before the no-spawn zone is removed.

look_test: Style flag on the existing fight scene, published to the preview folder, no release rows. Compare A: plain patrol that walks in and fights. Compare B: 3 s banner, one spoken call-in line, one harasser, then two backups arriving with a 15 s gap, capped at three. Judge at 375 wide: banner readable in one glance, line readable over the fight, three-person cap reads as an ambush not a crowd. Second flag: map faction chip showing lead 0, 1 or 2 tinting the enemies; judge whether it reads as escalation.
